rationale: Autonomous-agent SWE. Multi-step error compounding is a known failure mode in long-horizon agentic workflows (independent benchmark studies have flagged sub-30% completion rates on real-world tasks). Public posture is light: no RSP-equivalent, limited public red-teaming, governance disclosures are early-stage. Tool-call abuse (P3.4 deferred) is the dominant adversarial concern.
